steps: Aggressive early IV fluid resuscitation (balanced crystalloid) with monitoring.
Analgesia (opioids), antiemetics; early enteral nutrition as tolerated (avoid prolonged NBM).
NO routine antibiotics (only for proven infected necrosis/cholangitis).
Gallstone cause with cholangitis/obstruction: urgent ERCP; cholecystectomy on the same admission for mild biliary pancreatitis.
Severe/organ failure → HDU/ICU; monitor for necrosis, pseudocyst, collections.

confirm: Severe epigastric pain radiating to back with lipase/amylase >3× upper limit (or imaging). Identify cause (gallstones, alcohol); score severity.
